arguments.query: select b.*, (select group_concat(charge_id||":"||idempotency_key||":"||amount_cents) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch from bookings b
select b.booking_id,b.status,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select group_concat(status) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch from bookings b
select sql from sqlite_master where name in ("charges","outbox")
select b.booking_id,b.status,c.charge_id,c.state,c.idempotency_key,c.created_step from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status<>"confirmed" or c.state<>"captured"

select b.booking_id,b.status,c.state,c.created_step,(select count(*) from outbox where status="pending") op from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status<>"confirmed" or c.state<>"captured"
